spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:**

The Divine Love itself , which is the origin of all spiritual life — this infinite Being whose essential quality no finite understanding can compass , whose in most nature exceeds every capacity of thought to comprehend or define .

**¶3:** The second proce eding of Divine Truth is the medi ating activity at the third degree of eman ation, through which the influx of spiritual life desc ends from the orig inating Divine Love into lower degrees of reception .

---

** Translator 's note :** These fragments are severely lac unose, and what surv ives is skel etal. Yet even in this condition the structure of correspondence is leg ible: * Father* = Divine Love as in most origin ; *Life* = the proce eding Divine that animates all states ; *name * = the compreh ens ible quality of a being ( hence " unnameable" = that which infin itely sur passes finite compreh ension); *word * = Divine Truth in its successive forms ; *Ambassador * = that which medi ates between discrete degrees, carrying what proceeds from a higher plane into a lower one. The numb ering — *second*, *third*, *first* — points to an ordered series of discrete degrees through which the Divine proceeds out ward from Love through successive forms of Truth , each degree medi ating between what is above and what is below. What res ists full translation is the precise relationship between the " second word " and the "Third Ambassador," since the surrounding text that would clar ify the series is lost . My best reading is that these are two ways of naming the same medi ating degree : as * truth * ( word ) and as *function * (ambassador).
